subject: Energy
title: Types of Nuclear Waste
description: A fast breakdown of Types of Nuclear Waste for builders.

hook.text: Nuclear waste ranges from lightly contaminated gloves to intensely radioactive spent fuel rods.

buildup.text: Low-level waste (clothing, tools) makes up 90% by volume—it decays quickly and is stored in shallow repositories.

discovery.text: High-level waste (spent fuel) is only 3% by volume—but contains 95% of the radioactivity.

twist.text: All the spent fuel from 60+ years of US nuclear power would fit on one football field stacked 10 meters high.

climax.text: The small volume is both an advantage and a challenge—it's intensely concentrated and stays dangerous for millennia.

punchline.text: Small volume, extreme hazard—nuclear waste is a concentrated problem.

quiz.question: What percentage of radioactivity comes from high-level waste?
